Refresh pending approvals after BTW teardown

Recompute pending thread approvals when discarding a non-active BTW thread so hidden approval state does not linger in the footer after nested BTW teardown. Add a focused regression that exercises the real failure mode by switching away from a nested BTW stack with an approval on the hidden parent.
